---
title: "Environment Variables Echo - Quarto with Knitr"
format: html
engine: knitr
---

## CONNECT Environment Variables

```{r}
# Get all environment variables starting with CONNECT_
connect_vars <- Sys.getenv()
connect_vars <- connect_vars[grep("^CONNECT_", names(connect_vars))]

if (length(connect_vars) > 0) {
  cat("Environment variables starting with CONNECT_:\n\n")
  for (var_name in names(connect_vars)) {
    cat(sprintf("%s=%s\n", var_name, connect_vars[[var_name]]))
  }
} else {
  cat("No environment variables starting with CONNECT_ found.\n")
}
```

## Current Time

```{r}
cat("Current time:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"), "\n")
```
